session-end.description: End-of-session memory capture — saves learnings to .agents/memory/pending/
session-end.template: The session is ending. Use the question tool to ask the user: 'Want to save learnings from this session to .agents/memory/pending/? [y/n/edit]'. If yes, follow the session-reflector skill to draft and write the reflection. Follow the session-reflector skill Phase 0 → Phase 1 → Phase 3 workflow exactly.
